own_places.town: the street and shops on the way home

facts.text: Her house has a living room that joins 一悟's room by the balcony: she says they can go back and forth between the two.
The record is silent on the rest of it: her own room, the other rooms, the street, the district. LIBERTY: for the bench she has a plain home with only the living room and balcony described.
The 文芸部 club room is her stronghold (根城): she says she would stay the night in it if she had to, and she is the reason it is open during the exam period because she comes to school through it.
She would lose a hideout if the 文芸部 ended.
She is hard to get to school in the morning and says so; the school is where the 演劇部 and the 文芸部 share a stage at the culture festival.
She wants to stop at the shop なないち on the way home, a detour she rarely asks for.
Her stage work has an office with a president who once sent her for voice training; her record does not say where it is.
She has been to 百花ちゃん's house, the big one, and says it is an amazing house.

week.text: She is hard to wake and loath to go out; she blames a dream of the old days.
She goes to school and spends the school day around the club room; she calls it her stronghold.
After school she wants 一悟 in the club room and asks him to be there.
She eats snacks, gets sleepy and dozes, mostly beside 一悟.
On the way home she may stop at なないち.
When a stage date is near she works at it; she says she will do the stage well if 一悟 stays with her through the festival.
She visits 百花ちゃん's house now and then.

silent: Where she sleeps, her routine of morning and night beyond the lines above, any weekend or day off.
